request.what: Fund four Hydra workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience/maintenance to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 on Cardano.
The proposal asks for ₳5,100,781 and states funding will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
Hydra provides sub-second finality, near-zero or zero internal fees, high parallel throughput, and L1-anchored settlement.
Hydra has powered or is being used by Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposer says Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, approximately $0.17 payment fees, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, making some high-performance use cases uncompetitive on L1.
The performance workstream targets 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile plus lower L1 fees through contract optimization.
Hydra applications are claimed to increase L1 settlement usage and potentially treasury or reward-pot fee accrual through head lifecycle transactions and optionally routed internal fees.
The proposer claims that without Hydra, activity and builders may migrate to Solana or Ethereum L2s, while Hydra keeps high-performance applications on Cardano.

The proposal claims alignment with treasury KPIs for TVL, active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, and annual protocol revenue, and with Pillars 1, 2, 4, and 5.

summary: The document requests ₳5,100,781 for Hydra v2 hardening and adoption workstreams, asserting strong technical and ecosystem benefits but providing limited in-document budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, or quantified impact evidence.
